Key bugs: parse_u64 sets out=0 first, violating "out unchanged on failure" (e.g. "12x" leaves out=0, or overflow "99999999999999999999" wraps silently — no overflow check, contract says reject > UINT64_MAX). Also empty string accepted (returns true, out=0) — contract says nonempty only. Overflow wraps silently (no rejection). Registry: get returns string_view into vector while holding lock only during call; readers may retain view after get returns while add push_back can reallocate/move → dangling view. Also get doesn't check bounds (i >= names.size() → UB). Also names[i] on empty vector. Mutex held only during return — but string_view refers to string in vector; add can push_back causing reallocation → invalid view. Fix: return std::string (copy) or keep shared/atomic snapshot; or use deque of stable pointers. Also add's move: fine.

Minimal triggers:
1. out unchanged on failure: parse_u64("12x", out) with out=7 → returns false but out=0 (changed). Fix: only assign on success.
2. empty accepted: parse_u64("", out) returns true, out=0 — contract requires nonempty → violation.
